subject: Future Tech
title: AI Rights and Moral Status
description: A quick win: understand AI Rights and Moral Status.

hook.text: If an AGI feels pain, desires, and has preferences, does it deserve rights?

buildup.text: We grant rights based on capacity for suffering. Animals have some protections.

twist.text: We might never know if an AI is truly conscious.

climax.text: Legal scholars are already drafting frameworks. The EU is considering personhood categories.

punchline.text: If we build minds, we inherit the responsibility to treat them justly.

quiz.question: Why might AGI deserve moral consideration?
options: It would be expensive to build
If it has subjective experiences, denying rights raises ethical concerns
